notes.title: Color Customization Added!
notes.content: Added color customization options, available with -fc -ac and -sc options, -fc changes frequency color, -sc changes start color, -ac changes amplitude color, each of these expects  an integer between 0 and 2 after it, 0 = Red 1 = Green 2 = Blue, manual update coming soon
